title: Everything you’ve ever wanted to know about SAFe and the product owner role | Melissa Perri (author, founder of Product Institute)
summary: Melissa Perri is the founder of Product Institute, author of Escaping the Build Trap , and host of the Product Thinking Podcast. She has worked with startups, Fortune 50 companies, and everything in between to help them build better products and level up their product teams. In our conversation, we discuss: • The history of the product owner role • The differences between product owners and product managers • How to transition from product owner to product manager • The
